name: quetrex-setup
description: Log in, arm a repo for Quetrex, and keep the engine current. /quetrex-setup:login, /quetrex-setup:init, /quetrex-setup:update — enabled machine-wide so an unarmed repo gets only these three commands and a one-line offer, never the full pipeline. The pipeline itself (quetrex, quetrex-factory) is enabled per repo by /quetrex-setup:init.
